mandatoryCriteria: Both existing My Tasks routes retain one mandatory project and current actor assignment, membership and board-grant filtering before LIMIT.
Validated bounded pagination returns nextCursor; deterministic date-null-last/id ordering traverses all unchanged assignments without duplicates, including tied dates and null dates.
Due filters overdue/today/upcoming/none use workspace date, overdue excludes done; priority is optionally combined. Archived projects/boards and trashed cards are excluded.

Cursor context is bound to actor, project, workspace, filters, limit, workspace date and current board snapshot/access revisions; changes require restart with 409 STALE_CURSOR. Cursor is pagination state, never authorization.
Malformed query/cursor fails controlled 4xx; another project/user or revoked grant never exposes data. SQL and enrichment are bounded by page size.
Real mounted PostgreSQL tests fail before repair and pass afterward. Independent source-bound review remains required for closure.
